name: Mantra Capital Limited
about: Mantra Capital Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides investment and financial services in India. The company also offers secured business loans, such as loans against properties; and secured green loans, including EV financing. It serves entrepreneur-led businesses. The company was formerly known as Savani Financials Limited and change its name to Mantra Capital Limited in October 2025. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Mumbai, India.
